about: Concept figures: drawings that are not official signs (sign shapes, meaning badges, rule diagrams, car and safety pictures). Questions and learn cards reference them by id in fig / opt_figs / explain_fig, exactly like sign and marking ids. Drawings are registered in the Signs registry from src/signs/figs.js (group shape and meaning), src/signs/diagrams_road.js (group road) and src/signs/diagrams_car.js (group car). name is the Arabic caption shown under the figure in cards and feedback.

figs.name: الدوران عكس عقارب الساعة
figs.draw: Top-down 4-arm roundabout, one ring lane, central island. Three or four cars on the ring with light curved arrows showing ANTICLOCKWISE circulation (seen from above: N to W to S to E). Our car (white, gold outline) waiting at the give-way line of the SOUTH entry, facing north, in the right-hand half of the south arm

figs.name: الأولوية لمن داخل الدوار
figs.draw: Top-down roundabout, south entry close up. Our car stopped at the broken give-way line of the south entry. A car on the ring just to the WEST of the south entry, moving anticlockwise toward the east across the front of our car (it comes from our LEFT), with a green arrow on its path. A small gold marker on our car meaning wait

figs.name: المخرج الأول: المسار الأيمن وإشارة اليمين
figs.draw: Top-down 4-arm roundabout with 2-lane approaches. Our car in the RIGHT lane (lane 1) of the south arm with its right indicator lit; a gold route arrow from that lane onto the outer ring and out at the FIRST exit (the east arm, a right turn), ending in the right-hand lane of the east exit

figs.name: لليسار أو الالتفاف: المسار الأيسر
figs.draw: Top-down 4-arm roundabout with 2-lane approaches. Our car in the LEFT lane (inner, lane 2) of the south arm; a gold route arrow on the inner ring anticlockwise past the east exit and the north exit, then out at the THIRD exit (the west arm, a left turn). A small right-indicator mark on the route just after it passes the north exit (signal right after passing the exit before yours)

figs.name: تقاطع بلا تنظيم: الأولوية للقادم من اليسار
figs.draw: Top-down crossroads of two equal two-way roads with NO lines, NO signs, NO lights. Our car on the south arm (right-hand half) waiting before the junction, facing north. A blue car on the WEST arm (right-hand half for eastbound traffic, i.e. the southern half of the west arm) coming from our LEFT, with a green arrow going straight east across the junction. Our planned path straight north drawn dashed grey (wait)

figs.name: الانعطاف يسارا من أقصى اليسار
figs.draw: Top-down crossroads, two lanes each direction, centre line. Our car in the LEFT lane of the south approach (next to the centre line) with its left indicator lit. Gold arrow: into the junction, turning just left of the centre, and ending in the right-hand half (northern half) of the west arm, in its left lane. An oncoming car on the north arm shown with a green arrow going straight first

figs.name: الانعطاف يمينا من أقصى اليمين
figs.draw: Top-down crossroads, two lanes each direction. Our car in the RIGHT lane of the south approach with its right indicator lit. Gold arrow making a tight right turn close to the kerb into the RIGHT lane of the east arm (its southern half)

figs.name: الالتفاف للخلف من المسار الأيسر
figs.draw: Top-down divided road running up the screen: two lanes up on the right half, two lanes down on the left half, a raised median with an opening. Our car in the LEFT lane of the upward carriageway (next to the median) with its left indicator lit, a gold U-turn arrow through the median opening turning LEFT and ending in the left lane of the downward carriageway. A car coming down in the other carriageway a little further up, shown with a small give-way mark on our arrow

figs.name: التجاوز من اليسار فقط
figs.draw: Top-down one-way road with two lanes moving up. A slow truck in the RIGHT lane. Our car behind it: a gold arrow moving out to the LEFT lane, passing the truck, and returning to the right lane well ahead of it. A second faded path passing the truck on its right side with a red X on it

figs.name: الزم اليمين واترك اليسار للتجاوز
figs.draw: Top-down one-way road with three lanes moving up. Two cars cruising in the right lane and one in the middle lane; the LEFT lane has one car overtaking with a short arrow returning to the middle. Small grey arrows on the right lanes showing normal driving. No text except optional tiny lane tags

figs.name: قاعدة الثانيتين
figs.draw: Top-down straight road, one lane moving up, two cars in the same lane with a clear gap. A roadside marker (lamp post or sign pole) beside the road level with the rear of the car ahead. A gold dimension bracket along the gap labelled ثانيتان (Arabic) and small tick labels 1 and 2 along the bracket

figs.name: متر على الأقل عند تجاوز الدراجة
figs.draw: Top-down road with one lane each way and a broken centre line. A cyclist near the right kerb of our lane moving up. Our car overtaking it partly in the left side of the lane or across the broken line, with a gold dimension line between the car and the cyclist labelled 1 م

figs.name: النقطة العمياء
figs.draw: Top-down view of our car on a two-lane road moving up. Soft green translucent cones behind the car showing what the interior and side mirrors see. Red translucent zones just behind the car's rear quarters on both sides (outside the mirror cones) showing the blind spots. A car of another colour partly inside the left blind spot. A small curved arrow at our driver's head meaning turn your head

figs.name: مناطق الشاحنة العمياء
figs.draw: Top-down view of a long truck moving up in the middle of a road. Red translucent blind zones: directly in front of the cab, along the whole RIGHT side (largest), a narrower zone along the left side near the cab, and a long zone directly behind the trailer. One small car sitting inside the right-side zone

figs.name: لا وقوف على بعد أقل من 15 مترا من التقاطع
figs.draw: Top-down corner: a road moving up to a junction at the top. Along the right kerb just before the junction, a kerb strip marked with a red band and a small blue no-parking disc, and a gold dimension line labelled 15 م from the junction corner. Parked cars along the kerb stop before the red band

figs.name: الدخول إلى الطريق السريع
figs.draw: Top-down highway, three lanes moving up, with an on-ramp joining from the RIGHT into a parallel acceleration lane. Our car in the acceleration lane with its LEFT indicator lit, a gold arrow merging smoothly into the right lane (lane 1) into a gap between two cars. The acceleration lane tapers away further up

figs.name: الخروج من الطريق السريع
figs.draw: Top-down highway, three lanes moving up, with a deceleration lane opening on the RIGHT and an exit ramp veering right. Our car already in the right lane with its right indicator lit; a gold arrow into the deceleration lane and onto the ramp. A striped gore area (white chevrons) between the ramp and the main lanes

figs.name: فاتك المخرج؟ كمل للمخرج التالي
figs.draw: Top-down highway, three lanes moving up, just past an exit ramp that leaves to the right at the bottom of the picture (with its gore area). Our car in the right lane beyond the gore. A red dashed path cutting back across the gore to the ramp, and a red path reversing, both crossed with red X marks. A green arrow continuing straight ahead up the lane

figs.name: عند الانعطاف: المشاة أولا
figs.draw: Top-down junction corner: our car on the south approach turning right (right indicator lit) into the east arm. Across the mouth of the east arm a zebra crossing with two pedestrians crossing. Our car stopped before the zebra; a gold arrow of the turn stops at a short gold wait bar before the crossing

figs.name: مسافة التوقف: رد الفعل ثم الفرملة
figs.draw: Side view on a straight road: our car on the left at the start, an obstacle (a pedestrian or a warning triangle) far on the right. Under the road two coloured bars end to end: a gold bar labelled رد الفعل (the distance travelled while the driver reacts) and a red bar labelled الفرملة (the braking distance), with one long bracket above both labelled مسافة التوقف. A small eye icon at the start of the gold bar and a brake pedal icon at the start of the red bar

figs.name: الأضواء المنخفضة
figs.draw: Side view at night: car on the left with a short beam of light angled DOWN onto the road ahead (about a third of the picture). Dark background. Headlamp icon of dipped beam (lines slanting down) in a corner

figs.name: الأضواء العالية
figs.draw: Side view at night: car on the left with a long straight beam reaching far along the road (almost the full width). Dark background. Headlamp icon of main beam (straight horizontal lines) in a corner

figs.name: في الضباب: المنخفضة وأضواء الضباب
figs.draw: Front three-quarter or side view of a car in grey fog bands: dipped headlights on and front fog lamps on (short wide low beams). A small high-beam icon crossed out with a red X in a corner, and a hazard-light triangle icon crossed out beside it (hazard lights are not for driving in fog)

figs.name: تعطلت؟ الفلاشر والمثلث وانتظر خلف الحاجز
figs.draw: Top-down: the right edge of a highway moving up, with a hard shoulder and a crash barrier at the far right. A car stopped on the hard shoulder with both amber hazard lights lit (small flash marks). A red warning triangle standing on the shoulder well BEHIND the car (further down the picture), with a dashed gold line between them (no number). Two people standing beyond the barrier, on the right, ahead of the car

figs.name: عمق نقشة الإطار 1.5 ملم على الأقل
figs.draw: Close cross-section of a tyre tread block: grooves between tread blocks, a small depth gauge probe inside one groove, and a gold dimension line showing the groove depth labelled 1.5 ملم. A second small worn tyre profile beside it with almost no groove and a red X

figs.name: الحزام ومسند الرأس
figs.draw: Side view of a driver seated (simple figure) in a car seat: the seat belt crossing the shoulder and chest diagonally and low across the hips; the head restraint top level with the top of the head, close behind it; hands on the steering wheel with bent elbows. Small green check marks on the belt and the head restraint

figs.name: الطفل في مقعده في الخلف
figs.draw: Side cut-away of a car: a small child in a child seat on the REAR seat, belted in. A vertical height ruler beside the child with a tick labelled 145 سم near the top. The front passenger seat is empty

figs.name: الانزلاق المائي
figs.draw: Side close-up of a tyre riding on a layer of water: a blue water wedge in front of and under the tyre, the tyre lifted slightly off the road surface, spray behind. A small speedometer icon with the needle in the red area

figs.name: لا تدخل ماء أعلى من نصف الإطار
figs.draw: Side view of a saloon car in flood water: a blue water level line crossing the wheels at about HALF the tyre height, with a gold dimension mark on the front wheel showing half the tyre; a second deeper water line higher up drawn red with a red X

figs.name: ألوان أضواء لوحة العدادات
figs.draw: Three rounded panels side by side, dark background: a RED panel with red icons (oil can, battery, temperature thermometer in liquid) labelled توقف; an AMBER panel with amber icons (engine outline, ABS text, tyre pressure) labelled افحص قريبا; a GREEN or BLUE panel with icons (headlamp, indicator arrows) labelled معلومة

figs.name: غيارات الأوتوماتيك
figs.draw: Automatic gear selector seen from above: the letters P, R, N, D in a vertical slot, D highlighted gold, and small Arabic labels beside each letter: وقوف، رجوع، محايد، قيادة. The brake pedal icon beside P and R to remind that you press the brake to move the lever

figs.name: لا هاتف في يدك أثناء القيادة
figs.draw: A hand holding a mobile phone above the top of a steering wheel, crossed with a bold red diagonal bar inside a red rounded frame (not a UAE sign shape: use a rounded square frame, not a circle)

figs.name: مرآة ثم إشارة ثم التفاتة
figs.draw: Three steps in a row from right to left (Arabic reading order), each in a rounded tile with a number 1, 2, 3: (1) a side mirror with a car reflected, (2) an amber indicator arrow blinking, (3) a head turning over the shoulder (curved arrow). Thin gold arrows between the tiles pointing right to left

figs.name: النقاط السوداء: 24 نقطة تعني حجز الرخصة
figs.draw: A horizontal gauge of 24 small dots from right to left (Arabic reading order), filled black on a light track, grouped visually in fours; the last dot at the left end is replaced by a red marker with a small licence card icon and a red lock. Labels: 0 at the right end, 24 at the left end

figs.name: الركن الموازي خطوة بخطوة
figs.draw: Top-down yard, kerb on the RIGHT. A parallel space about 1.5 car lengths long between a front pole (or parked car) and a rear pole. Our car in three numbered ghost positions joined by a dashed gold reverse path: 1 stopped alongside the front pole or car, 0.5 to 1 m from it, rear bumpers level; 2 reversing at a clear angle into the space, steering toward the kerb; 3 final position parallel to the kerb inside the space, with a gold dimension line to the kerb labelled 30 سم. Small numbers 1, 2, 3 on the ghosts

figs.name: الكراج بالرجوع خطوة بخطوة
figs.draw: Top-down yard: a row of 90 degree bays on the RIGHT of a driving aisle. Our car in three numbered ghost positions joined by a dashed gold reverse path: 1 driving past the target bay about 1 m away from the bay ends, stopped when its rear is level with the far line of the bay; 2 reversing with full lock, angled into the bay; 3 straight inside the bay, stopped before the back line. Two short equal gold ticks between the car sides and the bay lines in position 3 (equal space in both mirrors)

figs.name: الموقف المائل 60 درجة
figs.draw: Top-down yard: a row of bays angled at 60 degrees to the driving aisle, on the RIGHT side, opening toward our direction of travel. Our car driving FORWARD into one bay on a smooth gold curve, starting slightly wide; final ghost position centred between the lines and stopped before the front line. A small arc marking the 60 degree angle between a bay line and the aisle, labelled 60°

figs.name: السيارة كلها داخل الخطوط
figs.draw: Top-down: two bays side by side. In the left bay a car with its side mirror and one corner crossing the bay line, a red outline on the part outside and a red X. In the right bay a car fully inside the lines with a green check. No text

figs.name: لا رصيف ولا عمود
figs.draw: Top-down parallel parking box with a kerb along the right and yard poles at both ends. One ghost car with its rear wheel mounted on the kerb (red mark) and its bumper touching a pole (red mark), crossed with a red X. Beside it the correct final position with a gap to the kerb and to both poles and a green check

figs.name: اتبع أسهم المسارات عند الدوار
figs.draw: Top-down 4-arm roundabout with a 3-lane SOUTH approach and painted lane arrows: right lane (lane 1) arrow to the right, middle lane arrow straight, left lane arrow left and U-turn. Three thin coloured route arrows from those lanes: right lane to the first exit (east), middle lane to the second exit (north), left lane round to the third exit (west). All circulation anticlockwise. Routes never cross each other inside the ring

figs.name: الطريق الرئيسي قبل الفرعي
figs.draw: Top-down T-junction without signs, lights or give-way lines: a wide main road running left to right with lane lines, and a narrow side road without markings joining from the SOUTH. Our car on the side road waiting at the mouth, facing north. A car on the main road passing in front with a green arrow. No text

figs.name: الشاحنة الطويلة تنعطف بزاوية واسعة
figs.draw: Top-down crossroads: a long truck in the right lane of the south approach with its RIGHT indicator lit, first drifting slightly left, then swinging wide into the east arm (a light grey swept-path arrow). Our car behind the truck waiting (gold wait bar). A faded car trying to pass on the truck's right side inside the gap, crossed with a red X

figs.name: حافلة مدرسية متوقفة وذراع قف مفتوح
figs.draw: Top-down undivided two-way road, one lane each way. A yellow school bus stopped at the RIGHT kerb facing up, its red octagonal STOP arm extended from its LEFT side and amber/red lights flashing at front and rear (flash strokes). Children at the kerb near the bus door. Our car further back in the same lane, still moving (no arrow, no check mark): the picture only sets the scene

figs.name: طريق باتجاهين: الجميع يتحرك يمينا
figs.draw: Top-down undivided two-way road, one lane each way, broken centre line. An ambulance with red and blue lights in our lane coming from behind (bottom). Our car ahead of it moving to the right edge (green arrow) and slowing; an oncoming car on the other side also moving to its own right edge (green arrow), leaving the middle free

figs.name: الانطلاق من جانب الطريق
figs.draw: Top-down: our car parked at the RIGHT kerb of a two-lane road moving up, LEFT indicator lit (flash strokes on the left corners). A curved gold arrow at the driver's head toward the left rear (look over the shoulder), and a dashed gold path merging smoothly into the lane once a car behind has passed (that car further up the lane)

figs.name: حادث بسيط: انقل السيارتين إلى مكان آمن
figs.draw: Top-down multi-lane road moving up: two faded ghost cars touching in the middle lane (small damage marks), dashed gold arrows from them to the two same cars now parked on the right shoulder / roadside with hazard lights lit. Two small people standing safely beyond the kerb, one with a phone icon (report)

figs.name: الأصفر: توقف إذا قدرت بأمان
figs.draw: Top-down approach to a signalised stop line with the signal head showing AMBER. The approach lane split into two coloured zones: a long zone further back tinted green where a ghost car stops before the line (green check), and a short zone just before the line tinted gold where a ghost car continues carefully (gold arrow). A thin dashed marker line between the zones. No text

figs.name: المنحدر: لا ترجع 30 سم
figs.draw: Side view: a ramp rising to the right with a white stop line on it; our car stopped at the line facing up the slope. Behind the rear wheel a short red zone with a gold dimension labelled 30 سم (the roll-back limit). A small round timer icon labelled 60 ث in a corner. Brake and accelerator pedal icons with a gold arrow from brake to accelerator

figs.name: الفرملة المفاجئة: مسافة الفرملة
figs.draw: Side view of our car braking hard on a straight road after a red stop signal: a gold bracket from the point where braking starts to where the car stops, labelled مسافة الفرملة. Beside it a small clean table of three rows: 20 كم/ساعة 3 م، 30 كم/ساعة 6 م، 40 كم/ساعة 11 م

figs.name: مسافة الأمان حسب الطقس
figs.draw: Three horizontal rows, each with a small weather icon on the right and a gold bar growing to the left (Arabic reading order): sun with the label ثانيتان (short bar), rain drops with 4 ثوان (longer bar), fog lines with 5 ثوان (longest bar). A tiny car icon at the start of each bar

figs.name: لا تعبر ماء جاريا مهما كان قليلا
figs.draw: Side view: a road dipping into a stretch of fast-flowing water crossing it (blue with white current arrows moving across). Our car stopped before the water. A red dashed path through the water crossed with a red X, and a green curved arrow turning back

figs.name: تاريخ صنع الإطار: الأسبوع ثم السنة
figs.draw: Close view of a tyre sidewall with the moulded text DOT and a code ending in a framed 2324. Two gold brackets under the framed digits: 23 labelled الأسبوع and 24 labelled السنة

figs.name: مسافة التوقف حسب السرعة
figs.draw: Three horizontal bars of increasing length, each starting at a small car icon (Arabic reading order: car on the right, bar growing to the left): 60 كم/ساعة 33 م، 100 كم/ساعة 87 م، 120 كم/ساعة 130 م. Bars drawn to scale with each other

figs.name: قبل النزول: الغيار على P
figs.draw: The same automatic gear selector as fig-gear-selector (P R N D with their Arabic words), but with P highlighted gold instead of D, and a small handbrake icon beside it
